name: Phreak v2 proto
author: Matt Policastro
description: 21 North American telephone tones with original bad-line treatment on MAIN and clean AUX. MIDI note 60 gives authentic Hz; pitch transposes every component by the same ratio. TRIG selects keypress bursts or unpatched cadence.

controls.label: Tone system
controls.description: North America, UK, Europe, Japan, blue box, specials (red box, SIT, howler), then modem.

controls.label: Line
controls.description: Clean at noon. CCW: analog line, telephone band then saturation. CW: digital line, band then bit/rate crush.

controls.label: Tone
controls.description: Selects an entry within the system, in equal zones with hysteresis and 0.005 s crossfades.

controls.label: Twist
controls.description: Balance of a pair's low and high tones: balanced at noon, one tone alone at either end.

outputs.main: Selected tone processed by TIMBRE; retains pitch, selection fades, unpatched cadence and patched LPG bursts. Equals AUX at TIMBRE 0.
outputs.aux: Selected tone untreated by TIMBRE; retains pitch, selection fades, unpatched cadence and patched LPG bursts.

trigger: Patched TRIG: each rising edge starts a 0.100 s LPG burst; idle is silent. Unpatched: dial/DTMF/FSK sustain; busy 0.5/0.5 s and ringback 2/4 s on/off cadence.
